# outputs

<!-- Generated by orb-weaver-kicad-board-docs from board.yaml and board-manifest.yaml; do not edit. -->

Subsystem sheet `/outputs` of **camera-gpio-interface-pcb**, from the board recipe `subsystems/outputs.subsystem.yaml`.

The four 3.3 V BNC outputs to the Neuropixels OneBox: SYNC OUT from its own SN74LVC1G125 driver on SYNC_IN through 470 Ω, and the three CAMn OUT lines the camera channels drive through their own 470 Ω; two USBLC6 clamps across the four jacks, referenced to +5V; an activity LED and the InstrumentPort tap on SYNC OUT.

Board note: board-authored sheet, 12 parts

## Notes

- Fixed at 3.3 V: the OneBox ADC inputs are high impedance with a ±5 V range, and anything fed back into a pyControl BNC must stay under that board's 3.3 V clamps. 470 Ω (0603, 1/10 W) rather than 50 Ω: a shorted BNC costs 7 mA, and a OneBox DAC left switched in on the shared pin holds the node at the clamp (about −0.8 V or +5.5 V) for 12 mA through the driver and 64 mW in the resistor, inside both ratings. Into a ~1 MΩ ADC input the resistor costs 0.05 % of amplitude and about 140 ns of edge.
- U401 (SN74LVC1G125, ~OE to ground) drives SYNC_OUT from SYNC_IN, a driver of its own so a fault on the OneBox cable cannot disturb the three camera drivers that share SYNC_IN; R402 (470 Ω) makes SYNC_OUT_BNC at J401. The CAMn_OUT_BNC nets arrive from the camera blocks already behind their 470 Ω and meet only their jacks and the clamps here: J402 CAM1, J403 CAM2, J404 CAM3.
- USBLC6-2P6 is a two-line array (pins 1/6 one node, 3/4 the other): U402 pairs CAM1 OUT with CAM2 OUT and U403 CAM3 OUT with SYNC OUT, VBUS on +5V. C401 decouples U401; U401 pin 5 is the package's NC pin, left open.
- D401 through R401 (680 Ω) shows activity on SYNC_OUT. R403 (100 Ω) taps SYNC_OUT to SYNC_OUT_INST (DIG2) at the driver output before the 470 Ω, so the InstrumentPort sees what the BNC carries.
